about: The fix is already installed, often through a later update, but the finding is still reported (stale plugin, stale vulnerability DB).

cases.why: Nessus's own output shows the installed version equals the fixed version.
A later RHEL errata (25.el7_9) superseded the one the check wants (21.el7_9).

findings.title: RHEL 7 : openssl (RHSA-2023:0001)
findings.plugin_output:
Remote package installed : openssl-1.0.2k-25.el7_9
Should be : openssl-1.0.2k-21.el7_9

cases.why: Debian deb11u5 is installed; the check asks for deb11u4.

findings.title: Debian DSA-0001-1 : openssl - security update
findings.plugin_output:
Remote package installed : openssl_1.1.1n-0+deb11u5
Should be : openssl_1.1.1n-0+deb11u4

cases.why: A later package update (1.2.4) includes the 1.2.3 fix.
Counterpart: credentialed scan, installed is below the fix.
Counterpart: the installed errata is older than the one required.
